name: Datashaper Glitch
text: This card can only be used as Synchro Meterial for Cyberse Synchro Monstes. While you control a 'Datashaper' Monster you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). When this card is sent to the GY. You can add 1 'Datashaper' Spell/Trap card from yoru deck to your hand/ You can only use each effect of 'Datashaper Glitch' Once per turn.
